$comment: Shared animation tokens. DEVELOPER CONFIG, not editable copy — do NOT hand this to the CMS. These cubic-bezier curves and spring settings were previously re-declared as a local `EASE` const in five different components, which meant a timing tweak had to be repeated five times and silently drifted. They are consumed through src/data/motion.js. Values are exactly the ones the components already used, so centralising them changes no animation.
